llm_summary_material: Process coffee cherries within hours of picking, and ferment washed beans 12–72 hours before washing to avoid spoilage and off-flavours.
Dry green coffee to about 11% moisture before hulling and grading, and target 205–215 °C for a medium roast just after first crack.
Site wind projects first: available power scales with the cube of wind speed, so doubling average wind speed raises yield about eightfold.
Accept that no turbine beats the 59.3% Betz limit — modern machines run 45–50%, with capacity factors of 35–45% onshore and >50% at the best offshore sites.
Treat utility-scale solar as the default cheapest new generation (~$0.048/kWh in 2021) and use CSP with molten-salt storage when power is needed after sunset.

Match EV charging infrastructure to the region's standard — CCS in Europe/North America, GB/T in China, CHAdeMO in Japan — and budget for 800 V architectures that add 200 km in ~15 minutes on DC fast charge.
Assume battery economics keep improving from ~$1,100/kWh (2010) to under $140/kWh (2023), with solid-state cells only at limited production around 2027 rather than broadly available.
Do not plan around black hole evaporation: a solar-mass hole takes ~10^67 years, so work instead from direct observation (EHT imaged M87 in 2019 and Sagittarius A* in 2022).
